mission_06: The Yeo-Johnson transformation extends the Box-Cox method to handle both positive and negative values, making it more versatile for real-world data. Financial returns, temperature changes, and profit/loss data often contain negative values that would cause Box-Cox to fail. In this mission, you will use sklearn's PowerTransformer with method='yeo-johnson' to normalize data with mixed signs. You will compare skewness before and after to see how effectively the transformation symmetrizes the distributions. This is the go-to power transform when your data is not strictly positive.
